name: tt-tournoi
description: TT Tournoi — Plateforme de gestion de tournois de tennis de table (Chelles TT). Mono-repo Next.js 15 + Fastify WS + PostgreSQL + Redis.

scripts.db:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env','packages/db/.env'); else console.warn('Pas de .env racine');"
scripts.db:generate: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma generate
scripts.db:push: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:studio: pnpm db:env && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma studio
